ModMetaData.name: ISEKAI — Balanced Stats [Star Sky Mods]
ModMetaData.author: chupakobra6 | Star Sky Mods
ModMetaData.description:
Automatically distribute ISEKAI stat points for colonists and pets, with a separate mode for each character.
FEATURES • Balanced mode spreads new automatic points evenly across all six stats. Existing stats, starting bonuses and manual allocations are preserved. • Class mode favours a colonist’s class stats while continuing to develop the others. Available after a class is assigned. • Pets can use Combat or Balanced mode and have their own automatic-allocation switch. Combat is the default, with STR/DEX/VIT weighted twice as heavily as INT/WIS/CHA. • Allocation skips capped stats and keeps its progress between levels and saves. Existing unspent pet points are spent shortly after loading when automatic allocation is enabled.
HOW TO USE Open a colonist’s or pet’s main ISEKAI tab. The mode button sits beside the automatic-allocation checkbox. Changing mode starts a fresh cycle for future points without changing earlier allocations. The controls follow the active ISEKAI or vanilla interface style.
MOD SETTINGS Toggle improved colonist allocation and pet allocation separately, choose defaults for characters without a saved personal choice, and hide mode-change messages. Turning off improved colonist allocation restores ISEKAI’s algorithm. Pausing pet allocation preserves unspent points. Global settings do not overwrite personal choices saved in the colony.
INSTALLATION RimWorld 1.6. Requires Harmony and ISEKAI RPG LEVELING. Load after them and any Guild/Creatures add-ons. English and Russian interface text is included.
UPGRADING FROM BALANCED STATS & QUICK QUESTS This is the same Workshop item and stat component: existing colonist and pet choices, allocation progress and stat settings remain in place. Middle-click quest acceptance has moved to the separate ISEKAI — Quick Quests mod. Subscribe to it to keep that feature.
BACKUP AND FEEDBACK Can be added to an existing save. Back up before removing a mod from an ongoing colony. Report problems with reproduction steps, mod versions and your log.
